raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the director by applying a flawed “first-listed-director” heuristic and treating Anthony Asquith (director of the British remake Unfinished Symphony) as the director of Gently My Songs Entreat. This conflated the British version with the 1933 Austrian-German original directed by Willi Forst, whose birthplace is Viennese. The failure to resolve the title/version ambiguity led the process toward the wrong director’s birthplace.
